high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "thecosmologicalway." The post features a vibrant, neon-lit room with a futuristic ambiance. The walls and ceiling are illuminated with pink and purple neon lights, creating a striking visual effect. The text on the walls reads "WHAT ARE YOU AFRAID OF?" repeatedly, adding to the mysterious and thought-provoking atmosphere. In the center of the room, there is a person wearing a long, flowing garment that appears to be a robe or cloak.
